Risks & challenges: RISK MANAGEMENT A well-defined risk management mechanism covering the risk mapping and trend analysis, risk exposure, potential impact and risk mitigation process is in place.

Threats (External) Intense and increasing competition; input cost volatility (lithium, cobalt, nickel, copper); risk of subsidy withdrawal/change; fast technology change; financing and charging- infrastructure constraints for end customers.

The Company has instituted a risk management framework to periodically identify, assess and mitigate these risks, and the Board and its Committees review key risks and mitigation measures on a periodic basis.
